facts.fact: NIBSS's circular concerns NIBSS Instant Payment transfers through bank mobile apps, online banking and USSD channels, with mobile money operators among the institutions addressed.
NIBSS's circular says licensed non-deposit-taking providers may use NIP outward transfers to pay salaries, taxes and pensions, under CBN guidelines on electronic payment of such items.
